objective: Complete prior recommendations without selecting regressions or substituting a partial acceptance gate.
decision: Reject all experimental replacements under required joint gain gate; retain selected913 and existing product sources.

ordinary_current_comparison.scope: Exact current selected913 versus isolated-target fresh cold-core and selective owner;3rotated12s repetitions per case/arm;27/27valid and fixed original client.

datagram_followup.scope: Fresh stockf011 source rebuild, exact selected913 and cold layout. Original fixed datagram client; identical recipes. Controls binary/build sensitivity before attributing loss/tail differences to the storage change.
datagram_followup.finding: Cold layout loss advantage did not reproduce. Unchanged selected image varies between cohorts; no causal or universal loss/tail win is established. Client UDP receive overflows are recorded separately and do not account for every missing update.

tls_controls.scope: Equal total allowed server CPU set for relay plus frontend versus QUIC; TLS1.3 trusted leaf on both. Frontend retains its extra TCP hop/tasks/copy buffers. This is a deployment comparison, not an optimized integrated WSS protocol lower bound.

ready_server_process.deployment_scope: Sum of relay and TLS frontend RSS/CPU; shared pages may be counted twice. Descriptors/thread details remain component-specific. Not a total kernel/physical-memory measurement.

selected_profile.scope: Diagnostic8s private1KiB fixed client; server/client profiled separately, cycles:u, no call graph, zero reported lost samples. Not timing medians or a complete CPU/kernel attribution.

causal_findings: Selective owner batching improves fanout36.05% and mixed31.42% against same-image uncoalesced owner, but final owner remains10.55-12.49% slower than selected.
Disabling retained synchronous private/control admission costs5.05% private and1.38% mixed; fanout already queued. This is not a complete additive decomposition.

Cold migration history shrinks core4656->4224bytes and saves41.40MiB RSS at100k; mixed throughput falls0.90%, reliable paced arrival-age p99 median worsens4.19->8.39ms. Datagram benefit did not reproduce.
Header layout shrinks PartialDecode120->64 and ConnectionEvent208->152bytes, but ordinary RSS saves only about2.55MiB and throughput has no consistent gain.
VAES/AVX2 crypto routines already execute; no measured justification for replacing QUIC/TLS/crypto with handwritten SIMD.
remaining_gaps: No candidate provides joint throughput/memory/latency improvement; plaintext-native memory parity remains unmet.
Optimized integrated TLS WebSocket comparison and complete process-plus-kernel accounting are not established; tested TLS frontend has extra hop/tasks/copy buffers.
Datagram tail/loss variability and client receive overflows prevent a stable improvement claim; arrival age is not freshest-state age under injected loss.
Residual owner cost is not fully causally decomposed; counter submissions are not exact syscall counts and sampled elapsed spans are not CPU time.
No new browser/injected-loss/bulk acceptance or deployment for rejected candidates.
Existing native origin-budget assertion remains unrelated and unfixed; no full-suite passing claim.

requirements_audit.policy_close: Reproduced before fix and verified after fix over local and sharded UDP/TLS/H3. Five new policy tests; correction remains in rejected experiment.
requirements_audit.packet_cost: Captured ingress/submission batching, queue depths, sampled handoff times, wakes and connection-drive counters. Separate user-cycle and heap profiles; no exact syscall or kernel-cycle claim.
requirements_audit.packet_experiment: Tested bounded cooperative batching; tested selective fanout hint and retained synchronous admission ablation. Same-image causal controls and exact-selected whole-workload comparisons retained.
requirements_audit.memory_experiment: Measured header and cold migration layouts, 100k ordinary RSS and separate live requested allocations. Migration behavior verified with real UDP port rebinding and 1MiB echo; 323 protocol tests.
requirements_audit.fair_controls: Fresh trusted TLS1.3 equal-client controls complete. Kernel accounting unavailable: SOCK_DIAG ENOENT on known live sockets, missing inet_diag module. Total-system parity remains unmet.
requirements_audit.candidate_acceptance: No proposed selected candidate: all fail joint throughput/memory/latency gate. Correctness, ordinary, capacity and offered-load screens complete. Browser and injected-loss/bulk freshness adoption gates not run for rejected variants; broader pivot not accepted.
requirements_audit.delivery: Frozen source/image/receipt evidence retained, invalid toggle/cache trial excluded, final isolated targets checked. Product374 inputs, selected image and six original heaps verified unchanged.

limits: Serialized pinned loopback workloads; histogram values are upper bounds. CapacityRSS snapshots are not continuous peak/PSS/total-system memory; allocator captures are separate. Prototype gains do not imply production selection. No push/deploy.
